title: Completeness of the internal quotient Roos output
statement: For a prime l and finite coefficient extension E/Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme X, and any K-flat complex P of the internal integral modules [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], the derived object represented by the actual strict quotient Roos complex roos(P) is IsDerivedComplete [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. The conclusion is completeness of the explicit completion output, with the specified augmentation, and has no assumption on boundedness or constructibility. The ambient module and derived categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Final coefficient interpretation and the output-completeness assertion of det-pbc-complete-derived-completion; Stacks Tags 099B and 0A0E.

proof.text: Choose d from the proved coefficient resolution, with its pointwise uniformizer property. Apply the normalized internal quotient/principal cone comparison to P, obtaining cP from its principal completion to Q(roos(P)).

Choose a flat-term K-flat quasi-isomorphism q:R -> roos(P). Let eR=asIso(Q(q)) and e=eR followed by inverse(cP). Thus Q(R) is isomorphic to the principal completion of P. Write v for the localized principal unit of R.

By surjectivity of precomposition with v into the principal completion of P, extend e.hom to r from the principal completion of R. Set s=r >> e.inv. Then v >> s=1. By injectivity of precomposition with v into the principal completion of R, v >> (s >> v)=v=v >> 1 implies s >> v=1. Hence v is invertible.

The normalized comparison cR for R gives Q(augmentation(R))=v >> cR.hom, hence this quotient augmentation is invertible. The witness R, its K-flatness, and eR establish the existential definition of IsDerivedComplete for Q(roos(P)).

lean.statement:
theorem isDerivedComplete_roos
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules l E X) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (Modules l E X) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) :
    IsDerivedComplete l E X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (roos l E X P))
